# dist/: build output and the MakerWorld listing

| File | Tracked | Edit? |
|---|---|---|
| `<slug>_makerworld.scad` | yes | **never**: generated by `scripts\build.bat`. This is the file you paste into PMM. |
| `<slug>_dev.scad` | no | **never**: generated by `scripts\dev_build.bat` for local previewing |
| `makerworld_listing.md` | yes | **yes**: the customer-facing listing text |

See [docs/toolchain/pipelines.md](../docs/toolchain/pipelines.md).
